module_summary: Clock-domain edge propagator with acknowledge: a TX-side sticky register holds the edge until the RX-synchronized level returns through a 2-flop ack synchronizer.

anchors.name: edge_i
anchors.why: TX-domain edge request setting the sticky input register

anchors.name: r_input_reg
anchors.why: Holds edge request until ack returns; serial input to RX synchronizer

anchors.name: sync_a
anchors.why: Two-flop TX-domain synchronizer shifting back the RX level as ack

anchors.name: ack_tx_o
anchors.why: Acknowledge to TX domain from synchronized feedback

anchors.name: sync_b
anchors.why: RX-synchronized level fed back into sync_a

groups.name: rx_sync_edge
